--- title: "Week 14 - Update" author: "Victoria Sjalim" date: "2026-10-26" format: html execute: freeze: auto --- # What is fix? ## Dimas fix the bug that related to duplication I pulled the github together from Dimas's and mine into the github copies. `https://github.com/Victoriasja18/eris` ## Precision Recall All the validations, including GFA (only with names) and FA (with location) can be found in `matrix.py` script. ### Validation for Simulated GFA ```{bash} # uv run eris -i ../data/EC958_complete_genome.fasta -d ../data/IS_n.mmi -o ../progress/result/dimas_fa -m collapse --merge-synonyms ``` Validation after merging with min identity = 0.75 ::: {#2349e3db .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import matrix as mt import pandas as pd # The simulated GFA was assembled from the chromosome only gt = mt.read_truth(mt.GT_CHROMOSOME, exclude=["ISSen10"]) gfa = mt.read_report("../result/dimas_gfa/dimas_gfa_report.tsv") summaries = [] for count_copies in (True, False): summary, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=count_copies) summaries.append(summary) display(pd.DataFrame(summaries)) # IS where eris and the truth disagree (copies counted) _, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=True) detail[(detail["FP"] > 0) | (detail["FN"] > 0)] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}

stitched locus first loci = read_gfa[read_gfa["target"].map(lambda t: mt.is_group(mt.is_name(t))) == mt.is_group(is_name)] locus = loci.sort_values("target", key=lambda t: ~t.str.endswith("_stitched")).iloc[0] path = pd.DataFrame({"Contig": locus["locus_contig"].split("|")}) path["Length"] = path["Contig"].map(lambda c: len(genome[c])) path["Depth"] = path["Contig"].map(genome.contig_depths).round(1) path["Depth / median"] = (path["Depth"] / median_depth).round(2) path[""] = "" path.loc[path["Depth"].idxmax(), ""] = "← max" print(f"\n{is_name}: eris copy number = {locus['copy_number']:.0f}") display(path) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Median depth of all contigs: 34.0 ISEc8: eris copy number = 2 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
